scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev -w @mofox/server" "npm run dev -w @mofox/web"
scripts.build: npm run check && npm run build -w @mofox/web && npm run build -w @mofox/server
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && npm run check -w @mofox/protocol && npm run check -w @mofox/server && npm run check -w @mofox/web
